title: MinStack.min is wrong after pop
body: `MinStack` in `structures/minstack.py` should report the smallest value currently on the stack in O(1). It only remembers one minimum, so after popping the current minimum `min()` keeps returning the value that is no longer on the stack. Duplicate values must be handled too: pushing 3 twice and popping once leaves 3 as the minimum. `pop()` and `min()` on an empty stack must raise `IndexError` (today `min()` returns `None`). `push`, `pop` and `len()` must otherwise keep working as now.
